title: Long-Tenancy Share of the Late Fee on Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreements
content:
**Terms.** The late fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries a tenancy share, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date to the handling date:

- an agreement in force **60 months or more** pays **80 percent** of the late fee;
- one in force **36 to 59 months** pays **90 percent**;
- a younger agreement pays it in full.

The share multiplies the late fee figured by the percentage on its basis, before that amount is rounded to the cent and compared with the late-fee floor. Whole calendar months are counted from the move-in date on the rental agreement record to the same day of a later month.

## Ladder with both sides

| Whole calendar months in force | Share paid |
|---|---|
| 35 | 100% |
| 36 | 90% |
| 59 | 90% |
| 60 | 80% |
| 61 and more | 80% |

## Hypothetical cases

- Move-in 20 May 2021, handling date 19 May 2026: 59 whole months, so 90 percent. On 20 May 2026 the count reaches 60 and the share becomes 80 percent.
- A percentage figure of $30.00 at 80 percent is $24.00 before rounding and the comparison with the floor; at 90 percent it is $27.00.
